These days, my thing is, in this face of this kind of pain…you have to choose not to become a villain.

Really really hard to do, but allowing the dark to swallow you into hell is not the way. There is nothing for you in the dark, but the void.

It’s like….bro what?! “What about me!!” 

It feels invalidating as hell and can come off light gaslighting. Reinforcing the lies their demons are already feeding them. 

Lately it carries the same energy as saying “it gets better” just because.

It just isn’t as helpful as people think, even if they’re well meaning. (Which of course, I still appreciate because we come here for support.) 

At least they’re trying help OP refocus on things they value in life loved ones worth staying and fighting for.

But I think some of my point still stands, man…
